authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
sections: 9 AcDb:Header; AC1012 prefix through model-space UCSNAME

scope: Extend the existing generated-pair HEADER prefix audit through current handles, paper-space and model-space coordinates/UCS.
checks: The independent bit walker records 122 field spans over the first 2,752 of 3,760 payload bits in each file; its values agree with LibreDWG 0.14 minJSON.

The five selected current-object handles bind to the expected layer, text style, linetype, dimension style and multiline style object types and names in the 32-object source census; HANDSEED is above all observed handles.

Repaired-CRC wrong viewport and current-layer handle roles, an invalid bitdouble tag and a changed DIMASO value are rejected; a mismatched decoded layer target type is rejected, and clean input succeeds after each control.
The combined source census and focused legacy BLOCK_HEADER adapter probe pass for both drawings. No generated fixture is committed.
limits: The producer and peer decoder are both LibreDWG; the Python wire walk is independent of libdxfrw, but not an independent producer or native acceptance witness.
The remaining 1,008 payload bits, native field semantics, complete graph/output, normal-open and dictionary cloning remain unqualified.
